status: visual design concepts, not implemented desktop screens
intent: Selection changes the layout: selected feature docks front-facing on the right; the entire project hierarchy and real module space move into a bottom browser.
common: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished wide 16:9 full-window Windows desktop interface for DEPTH AI. A professional spatial software development platform for web, app and game projects. This is a NEW LAYOUT, not a recoloring of the previous reference. Highest priority is readable clickable selected content. Input image roles: original ivory reference supplies ONLY the PRE-EXISTING blue faceted geometric Depth AI brand symbol beside 'DEPTH AI' and a sense of layered glass quality. Preserve that old blue faceted symbol, do not invent a gold triangle, letter A or Meta infinity logo. Previous beige reference supplies ONLY sample web-cart content and CLI/API agent workflow, NOT its palette, angled right-hand wall or right-side project hierarchy. Screen must be viewed straight-on, no monitor photograph, no external environment, no perspective applied to the entire application. 3D is expressed by project-space depth, layered glass body thickness, physical module thumbnails and restrained luminous edges. In selection mode, EVERY preview, title, property, text label, code line and clickable module surface faces the viewer at zero angle. All selected content has generous readable type, aligned crisp controls and sufficiently opaque surfaces behind text. No oblique/skewed editor or slanted selected module faces. Short accurate English labels. Persistent front-facing left web-cart behavior preview: header 'Behavior preview', small tag 'Reconstructed', title 'Your cart', a ceramic mug $48 and small plant $72, subtotal $120, coupon WELCOME20 and blue 'Apply' button. At discount20% show discount24 and total96; at discount25% show discount30 and total90. It is an illustrative source-linked behavior view, not a constantly running engine. Useful functional modules: CouponInput, ValidateCoupon, ApplyCoupon, CartState, TotalsView. Meaningful small icons and UI/image/type swatches represent real example modules/assets; no essays on fonts. One canonical shared pricing implementation, linked to cart and checkout. AI notes are short source-backed purpose/design/evidence summaries, not user comments or hidden chain-of-thought. Existing Codex CLI and API Agent are two tabs on a common work dock beneath the preview; API agent has actual composer/send, context chip, module/source activity and proposal review. No invented Depth CLI. No source-write or test-success claims. Avoid dense node spaghetti, tiny obligatory labels, decorative empty cubes, warm beige/brass/olive theme, excessive neon fog and generic white dashboard with only blue buttons.
focusLayout: MANDATORY FOCUSED LAYOUT: thin titlebar across top. Upper main region approximately 76% window height, with a left column 38% width containing preview above a compact usable CLI/API work dock, and a right column 60% width containing the SELECTED FEATURE WORKBOARD. This right workboard is a flat FRONT-FACING docked panel with crisp dark text (or light text in dark mode); it has title 'Apply coupon', breadcrumb 'Checkout / Apply coupon', tabs 'Composition', 'Code', 'AI notes', 'Changes', a readable role-based constituent arrangement and inline properties. Do not draw a receding module wall behind this workboard. Bottom approximately 20% window height, full application width: a dedicated 'Project structure' browser. Its bottom-left portion is a compact searchable semantic hierarchy with Checkout, Catalog, Shared, Assets and child entries; bottom-right remainder is a horizontal shallow 3D strip of MANY REAL SMALL PROJECT MODULES in neighborhoods, with selected source modules highlighted and dim origin markers. BOTH the global hierarchy AND the project module field are BELOW the main preview/workboard, not in a tall right sidebar. Source-origin link paths may rise subtly from the bottom strip to the workboard, only 2-3 useful connections. The settled selected module surfaces, preview, code, hierarchy and controls are all front-facing and unobscured. The bottom field can have shallow depth and angled tiny bodies. The workspace has genuinely changed its layout when focused: project whole below, selected structure at right, preview at left. No overlapping floating editor in the center of the preview.
lightPalette: META/SPATIAL LIGHT ATMOSPHERE: luminous cool pearl/silver glass, airy white-to-pale-periwinkle depths, translucent crystalline layered shells, restrained azure blue and violet/cyan iridescent rim reflections. Deep ink/navy text with strong local contrast. Saturated blue may be used for focus, connection and small action controls; color comes from depth, materials and optical light, not a flat white-and-blue dashboard. A light-mode professional metaverse creation environment: calm, precise, advanced and visually striking. No beige, gold, bronze or sage. Text-bearing workboard more opaque/frosted than background. Preserve the old BLUE faceted Depth AI symbol.
darkPalette: MATCHING META/SPATIAL DARK ATMOSPHERE: deep midnight navy/ink and smoked violet glass, pearly white text, controlled azure/cyan focus and violet iridescent edges, subtle layered light. Cinematic spatial depth without losing interface contrast. No warm bronze or olive. Critical work surfaces have quiet solid contrast. Same old BLUE faceted Depth AI logo and same functional layout as light mode.

screens.scene: EXPLORATION MODE BEFORE SELECTION. Left 40%: readable reconstructed web-cart preview above a compact API Agent / Codex CLI dock. Subtotal120 discount20% total96. Right 58%: the real project module space is the main spatial scene, with many small physical glass module tiles extending into depth in Checkout, Catalog, Shared, Assets and Accounts neighborhoods. Nearby representative tiles show real purpose via tiny code, a button swatch, an asset thumbnail, state value or icon. Farther modules group into summarizing stacked strata. A compact front-facing overview hierarchy can sit INSIDE the right scene's left edge, not across selected content. No selected feature workboard yet. A small 'Select in preview' control suggests the Apply button is selectable. The atmosphere is luminous silver/pearl glass and blue/violet depth. No giant foreground font card or fake tutorial. This exploration state will transform into a front-facing right workboard with the whole project moved BELOW when an element is selected.

screens.description: 프리뷰의 Apply를 선택한 상태입니다. 기능 구성은 오른쪽 정면 작업판으로 펼쳐지고, 프로젝트 하이어라키와 전체 모듈 공간은 아래 탐색대로 내려갑니다.
screens.scene: HERO SCREEN: the user selected Apply in the left preview; this is the final settled FOCUSED layout, NOT a perspective view. Left preview subtotal120, discount20%, total96, selected Apply has an azure outline. Left work dock below: API Agent active, a context chip 'Apply coupon', message composer and an unobtrusive 'Ask about this feature' prompt. RIGHT front-facing large workboard titled 'Apply coupon' with Composition active. Within a subtly layered translucent feature envelope, show intelligible constituent roles: compact CouponInput and ValidateCoupon at upper left, prominent ApplyCoupon rule surface at center, CartState input values below/left and TotalsView output at right. Readable directed links say 'valid coupon', 'cart subtotal', 'updated total' where useful. This is a clear role-based arrangement with nested grouping, not a giant file tree or arbitrary tile grid. The ApplyCoupon member has an editable property 'Discount % 20', source anchor 'src/cart/coupon.ts' and a brief meaningful note 'Shared pricing rule for Cart + Checkout'. A small inspector section WITHIN the right workboard can show selected module properties, but NO tall global hierarchy at the right edge. Bottom full-width Project structure dock clearly contains the GLOBAL hierarchy at left and the many small real project modules in a shallow depth strip to its right. Some originating module thumbnails glow azure/violet, with one or two subtle upward source links to the foreground assembly. Buttons 'View source', 'Review change'. The scene must unmistakably show a usable front-facing work area on right and the overall project BELOW it.

screens.scene: FOCUSED DETAIL / API AGENT SCREEN, same layout as hero. Right workboard has selected ApplyCoupon module expanded into a readable SOURCE and properties view, all front-facing. Code path 'src/cart/coupon.ts', source excerpt exactly 'export function applyCoupon(subtotal: number, discountPercent: number) {' then '  return subtotal * (1 - discountPercent / 100);' then '}'. Inline editable property 'Discount % 25', Draft badge. Short AI design summary adjacent to source: 'Purpose: apply coupon to cart totals.' 'Design: one pricing rule for Cart + Checkout.' 'Evidence: source-linked; runtime not observed.' Only concise verified-design-summary style. Left upper preview subtotal120 discount25%=30 total90 with a small before96→draft90 badge. Left lower API Agent dock shows user 'Make the coupon discount 25%.', activity 'modules.search', 'source.read', 'Proposal ready · 1 file', Review change action, real message composer and Send button; provider/model shown generically, key icon connected without exposing secret. Bottom full-width PROJECT hierarchy + physical miniature module strip remains visible and contains the same selected sources. Do not recreate a tall right-side project tree or angled source code wall.
